findings.title: The page does not say what the 30-day trial costs or commits the owner to, and nothing backs up the promise

location.description: the "Start a 30-day trial" button and the empty lower part of the page under the feature lines

findings.viewer_experience: The owner cannot tell whether "30-day trial" means a free month or a first paid month, so the wrong reading can stop the click. The "Pricing" and "Shops using it" nav links point to nothing on this page.

current.value: No trial terms under the button, no comparison, price, or named shop; lower part of the page empty

findings.target: One line of trial terms directly under the button, and the lower part of the page used for a comparison with how the owner now finds out what to reorder, plus the price or a real shop. The maker must supply the facts: whether the trial is free, whether a card is needed, what happens after day 30, the price, and which shops use it.
findings.fix_direction: Put one line of trial terms directly under the "Start a 30-day trial" button. Use the empty lower part of the page to compare Shelfmark with how the owner now decides what to reorder, and add the price or a real shop. The maker must supply every fact: trial cost, card needed or not, what happens after day 30, price, and shops using it.

closed_when.check: In the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, a line of trial terms sits directly under the "Start a 30-day trial" button, and the lower part of the page holds a comparison and a price or a named shop.

findings.title: On the tablet the hero paragraph and feature lines still run 78 and 81 characters per line

location.description: the hero paragraph and the feature lines on the tablet

findings.viewer_experience: The lines are longer than the 75-character target, though better than before (94 and 87).

current.value: 78 characters per line (hero paragraph), 81 (second feature line)

findings.fix_direction: Bring the width cap down from 600 px to about 560 px so the lines meet 75.

closed_when.check: characters_per_line of div.hero-text > p and of section.facts > p:nth-of-type(2) in the tablet viewport is 75 or less

findings.title: On the tablet the first two feature lines each end on a lone word

location.description: the first two feature lines on the tablet, ending in "happen." and "take."

findings.viewer_experience: Each block ends on one word alone on its second line.

current.value: "happen." and "take." sit alone on their own line

findings.target: "happen." and "take." no longer sit alone on their own line
findings.fix_direction: The narrower measure from the tablet-text-measure fix should break each line earlier. Check that the lone words are gone.

closed_when.check: In the tablet image, "happen." and "take." no longer sit alone on their own line.

findings.title: The reorder table has no order quantity, and the maker has not said whether the product suggests one
findings.viewer_experience: The table has Title, On shelf, and Sold this week only; an owner may expect to see how many copies to order.

current.value: Three columns: Title, On shelf, Sold this week

findings.target: If the product suggests how many copies to order, the table has that column. If not, the table stays as it is.
findings.fix_direction: The maker must say whether the product suggests how many copies to order. If it does, add that column. If not, leave the table as it is.

closed_when.check: In the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, the table has an order-quantity column if the maker said the product suggests one; otherwise the maker has confirmed it does not and the table is unchanged.

findings.title: On the phone the "Sold this week" column ends about 8 px from the right edge of the card

location.description: the "Sold this week" column of the table on the phone

findings.viewer_experience: The column looks cramped against the card edge, while the text to its left has 12 px or more of space.

current.value: about 8 px from the right edge of the card

findings.target: about 12 px of right padding, the same as the left edge of the card
findings.fix_direction: Give the last cell the same right padding as the left edge of the card, about 12 px.

closed_when.check: In the phone image, the "Sold this week" column ends about 12 px from the right edge of the card, level with the space at the left edge.
